scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @saystrike/api" "npm run dev --workspace @saystrike/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && npm run dev --workspace @saystrike/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && npm run dev --workspace @saystrike/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @saystrike/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @saystrike/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && npm run test --workspace @saystrike/api && npm run test --workspace @saystrike/web
scripts.build: npm run sync:audio && npm run build --workspace @saystrike/shared && npm run build --workspace @saystrike/api && npm run build --workspace @saystrike/web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
